headline: Signed five chapter land liens and two monthly motor vehicle abatement reports.
summary: Reviewing a new personal property growth report began at this meeting. The Senior Work off Policy was scheduled to go before the Select Board, but the Assessors' Office asked to postpone it until the next meeting for further review. The meeting also went into executive session to review abatement and exemption applications.
decisions: Accepted the open session and executive session minutes of August 25, 2026, unanimously.
Signed the July Monthly Motor Vehicle Abatement Report.
Signed the August Monthly Motor Vehicle Abatement Report.
Signed five Chapter Land Liens on properties on Wheelock Road, Main Street, Hough Road, Eight Lots Road, and Central Turnpike.

plain_text:
TOWN OF SUTTON
BOARD OF ASSESSORS
 4 UXBRIDGE ROAD
SUTTON, MA  01590-1702
  508-865-8722
Meeting Minutes – September 8, 2026
Present: Robert Nunnemacher, Chairman
  Matthew Read, Assessor
Meeting called to order at 5:08 p.m.
1.         The Board voted unanimously to accept the open session meeting minutes and executive session
            meeting minutes of August 25, 2026
2.         Old & New Business
The Board started to review the new personal property growth report
The Board is reviewing the Senior Work off Policy – the policy was going before the Select Board on
September 8, 2026 but the Assessors’ Office asked for it to be postponed until their next meeting to further
review
3.         Decisions & Actions Taken
The Board signed the July Monthly Motor Vehicle Abatement Report
The Board signed the August Monthly Motor Vehicle Abatement Report
The Board signed five (5) Chapter Land Liens:
49, 30R, 40, 62 & 68R Wheelock Road
69 Main Street
20 Hough Road
96 Eight Lots Road
349 Central Turnpike
4. Adjourned Open Session @ 5:40 to enter into Executive Session regarding
            Abatements/Exemptions
The Board entered into executive session to review abatement and/or exemption applications pursuant
to Massachusetts General Laws Chapter 59, Section 60, and Chapter 30A, Section 21, Item number 7. We are 
meeting in executive session to comply with Chapter 59, Section 60, which limits inspection of Chapter 59 
abatement and exemption applications to assessors and the deputies, clerks and assistants of the assessors, and 
certain other parties listed in the law. Chapter 30A, Section 21, Item number 7 permits public bodies to meet in 
executive session for the purpose of complying with general laws. 
The Board of Assessors adjourned its open meeting at or about 5:45 p.m. 
Respectfully Submitted,
Linda Hicks, Assistant Assessor
